elements.explanation: One of 92 original sculptural panel positions, presented without copied relief sculpture.
Exterior Doric perimeter and secondary porches form separate counted systems.
Separate east and west chambers, without a connecting passage.
Continuous Ionic architectural band around the cella; actual sculptural procession omitted.
Terminal piers in the eastern U-shaped internal Doric support system are documented in an architectural plan interpretation; their modeled size and positions are not surveyed.
